cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: On the Move.

words.en: Mia comes to my house after school.
words.scene: Lily opening the front door to let Mia in, both smiling.
more: Grandma comes to visit us on Sunday.

words.en: Dad comes back from work at five.
words.scene: Dad walking through the front door, Lily and Tom running to hug him.
more: The birds come back in spring.

words.en: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max running towards a green park gate.

words.en: The train arrives at the station.
words.scene: A blue train stopping at a platform, Lily waving to someone on board.
more: Sam arrives at the party at six.
Sam 六点到达聚会现场。

words.en: Please bring your bag to school.
words.scene: Mum bringing a plate of cookies into the living room, Lily and Tom smiling on the sofa.
more: Mum brings some cookies for us.
妈妈给我们带了一些饼干。
Can you bring me a glass of water?

words.en: Don't forget to bring the book back.
words.scene: Lily putting a library book into her bag, standing by the door.
more: Tom brings his toy car back home.
Tom 把他的玩具车带回家了。
We bring back some flowers from Grandma's house.
我们从奶奶家带回一些花。

words.en: Dad carries the heavy box upstairs.
words.sz: 爸爸把重箱子搬到楼上。
words.scene: Dad walking up stairs carrying a large brown cardboard box.
more: I can carry my school bag myself.
The dog carries a ball in its mouth.

words.en: Look left and right before you cross.
words.sz: 过马路前先看左右两边。
words.scene: Lily holding hands with Mum, walking across a zebra crossing on a street.
more: Be careful when you cross the road.
We cross the bridge to get home.

words.en: Tom drops his ice cream on the floor.
words.sz: Tom 把冰淇淋掉在地板上了。
words.scene: Tom looking sad at a puddle of melted ice cream on the kitchen tiles.
more: Leaves drop from the trees in autumn.

words.en: Max runs too fast and falls over.
words.scene: The puppy Max tumbling onto his side on the grass, legs in the air.
more: Be careful not to fall over!
Tom fell over but he is fine.

words.en: Please follow me to the car.
words.scene: Mum walking ahead with a handbag, Lily and Tom following her down the street.
more: Follow the signs to the park.
沿着指示牌走到公园去。

words.en: Lily gets a new bike for her birthday.
words.sz: Lily 生日时得到了一辆新自行车。
words.scene: Lily smiling happily, standing next to a shiny blue bicycle with streamers on the handles.
more: What time do you get home?
I want to get some fresh milk.

words.en: When do you get back from school?
words.sz: 你什么时候从学校回来？
words.scene: Lily and Tom getting back home from school, opening the front door with their school bags, Max jumping to meet them.
more: We get back home at six o'clock.
The bus gets back to the stop soon.
公共汽车很快就会回到车站。

words.en: We get off the bus at the corner.
words.sz: 我们在拐角处下公交车。
words.scene: Lily and Tom stepping down from a red double-decker bus onto the pavement.
more: Please get off the chair carefully.
请小心地从椅子上下来。
Dad gets off his bike to say hello.
爸爸从自行车上下来打招呼。

words.en: Let's get on the train now.
words.scene: Lily holding Dad's hand, stepping up onto a train carriage.
more: Tom gets on his bike and rides away.
Tom 骑上自行车骑走了。
Be careful when you get on the bus.

words.en: I get up at seven o'clock.
words.scene: Lily stretching in her bed, sunlight coming through the window curtains.
more: Tom gets up late on Sundays.
It's time to get up and brush your teeth.

words.en: Lily hits the ball with her racket.
words.scene: Lily swinging a tennis racket to hit a yellow ball over a net.
more: The rain hits the window hard.
雨点重重地打在窗户上。

words.en: Mum holds my hand in the park.
words.sz: 妈妈在公园里牵着我的手。
words.scene: Close up of Mum's hand holding Lily's small hand, walking on a path.
more: Can you hold this bag for me?
你能帮我拿一下这个袋子吗？
Tom holds his bear in bed.
Tom 在床上抱着他的熊。

words.en: The rabbit jumps over the wall.
words.scene: A white rabbit mid-air, jumping over a low brick garden wall.

words.en: Tom kicks the football hard.
words.scene: Tom kicking a black and white football in the park, one leg raised high.
more: Max tries to kick the ball.

words.en: Mum pulls the heavy door open.
words.scene: Mum pulling a wooden garden gate towards her, leaning back slightly.

words.en: Lily pushes the door.
words.scene: Lily pushing a heavy wooden door open with both hands.

words.en: Put your shoes by the door.
words.scene: Lily placing her red trainers neatly on a mat near the front door.

words.en: Grandma sits in her armchair.
words.scene: Grandma sitting comfortably in a large, cosy armchair reading a book.
more: Please sit down at the table.

words.en: The class sits down quietly.
words.scene: A group of children in school uniforms sitting down on chairs in a classroom.
more: Mum asks Tom to sit down.

words.en: Dad stands in the kitchen.
words.scene: Dad standing upright in a modern kitchen, hands at his sides.

words.en: Lily turns the page of her book.
words.scene: Lily's hand turning a page in an open storybook.

words.en: Sam dives into the pool.
words.scene: Sam jumping headfirst from a diving board into a blue swimming pool.
more: Fish dive deep in the sea.
Be careful not to dive here.

words.en: Uncle Ben sails his boat.
words.scene: Uncle Ben steering a small white yacht with a large sail on blue water.
more: We learn to sail in summer.
我们在夏天学习帆船运动。

words.en: Lily cycles to school.
words.scene: Lily riding a bicycle along a pavement, wearing a helmet and backpack.
more: 我们在公园里骑自行车。

words.en: Mum hurries to the bus stop.
words.sz: 妈妈匆匆忙忙去公交车站。
words.scene: Mum walking quickly towards a bus stop, looking at her watch.

words.en: We wait for the train.
words.scene: Lily and Tom standing on a platform, looking down the tracks for a train.

words.en: Please pass the salt.
words.scene: Dad passing a small salt shaker to Mum across a dinner table.
more: Lily passes the ball to Tom.

words.en: Tom shuts the window.
words.scene: Tom reaching up to push a window shut in a bedroom.
more: 妈妈合上她的笔记本电脑。

words.en: Sam enjoys climbing trees.
words.scene: Sam high up in a large oak tree, holding onto branches.

words.en: We go walking in the park.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max walking along a path in a green park on a sunny day.

words.en: Tom is running fast.
words.scene: Tom running on a track, legs moving quickly, arms swinging.
